idea-plugin.name: AI Companion Safety Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Reads your companion chatbot's system prompt against California SB 243, New York GBL Article 47, Illinois HB 1806 (WOPR Act) and Nevada AB 406, line by line.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → AI Companion Safety Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/ai-companion-safety-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/ai-companion-safety-lint

action.text: AI Companion Safety Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run AI Companion Safety Lint on the file in the editor
